notes: Trust root for AEGIS TT-STG DONE records (AS-25 / decision D33). A demonstration binding
(vigil-aegis-tt-demonstration-v1) verifies only under THIS non-production root.
The TT evidence key is a DEDICATED key held KMS-wrapped in the staging control plane; it is
NEVER a CI runner key and NEVER the production root (plan §13.3). Only its PUBLIC key is
committed here, by the AS-26 key ceremony, at which point `status` becomes `provisioned` and
Until provisioned, this root is honestly empty: load_trust_root_doc returns trust_root=None and
the verifier fails closed (no record can verify), so an unprovisioned root can never be mistaken
for a usable one. A production environment value is refused by the verifier regardless.
